REGULATORY UPDATE9 September 20268 min read

New artists’ employment regulations: what changes in 2027.

Royal Decree 607/2026 creates a new framework for the special employment relationship of artists and will replace the 1985 rules.

KEY POINT

The new rules have been published but take effect on 25 May 2027. Until then, the current framework continues to apply.All resources ↗

Royal Decree 607/2026 creates a new framework for the special employment relationship of artists and will replace the 1985 rules.

01

An updated scope

The rules broaden and clarify artistic activities and the inclusion of technical and auxiliary staff directly linked to performance.

02

More contractual detail

There is a stronger need to document duties, duration, the reason for fixed-term status, pay and essential conditions.

03

A transition to prepare

Organisations and productions should review templates, contract models, processes and coordination before the effective date.

04

Each date has its applicable law

Contracts and engagements before and after the change must be assessed under the framework in force at that time.

Practical review

What to review now

  • Artistic, technical and auxiliary roles used.
  • Contract templates and reasons for fixed-term hiring.
  • Schedules, remuneration and communication systems.
  • Registration, deregistration and production close-out procedures.
